---
name: Bug report
about: Something does not work as the docs say
labels: bug
---

**What happened**

**What you expected** (link the docs page that says so, if there is one)

**How to reproduce** (commands, request, or clicks)

**Where** (live app, local, self-hosted; Node version; `npm test` output if relevant)

**Evidence** (error text, delivery id, event id, transaction hash). Never paste keys, secrets or `.env` contents.
